{{Top|leg}}
A '''Dragite lens''' was a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Focusing lens/Legends|focusing lens]] created using a [[Dragite crystal]]. Although the crystal was typically used as a focusing crystal, as a lens it was capable of strengthening the lightsaber beam, inflicting an increased amount of damage.

*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
